blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The application for asylum of Harry Roque, former spokesperson for then-President Rodrigo Duterte, has been denied, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said on Tuesday. Roque is wanted over human trafficking charges in connection with an alleged Philippine offshore gaming operator in Pampanga. Roque is reportedly in Austria seeking asylum, citing political persecution. READ: Remulla confident of catching Dela Rosa, Roque “Na-deny ang asylum [application] ni Harry Roque.
